newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BALTIC TRANSIT BANK 7MO PROFIT 1.03MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BALTIC TRANSIT BANK 7MO PROFIT 1.03MLN LATS.

text.p: Baltic Transit Bank, one of Latvia's largest banks, said on Tuesday that its seven month profit came to 1.03 million lats against 1.78 million lats in first half of 1997.
The bank said in a statement that its assets reached 57.92 million lats after seven months, a growth of 6.5 million since December 1996.
It also said that its own capital was 8.4 million lats, a rise of 720,000 lats compared to December 1996.
The bank said that its deposits in July were 37.13 million lats against 36.41 million lats in June and loans came to 19.8 million lats against 20.2 million lats the month before.
